name: Text to Audio
description: Converts text files to speech through the shared AI Provider plugin and writes the files into a folder you choose. Optionally imports the generated audio into the Cove library.
author: binarygeek119

settings.name: inputFolder
settings.description: Folder of text files to convert. Searched recursively for .txt and .md files.

settings.name: outputFolder
settings.description: Folder where generated audio files are written. Add this path as a Cove library folder if you want scans to pick them up too.

settings.name: voice
settings.description: Voice ID for the selected model. Empty uses the AI Provider default.

settings.name: model
settings.description: Speech model. Empty uses the AI Provider default.

settings.name: format
settings.description: Output format. Empty uses the AI Provider default. Options: mp3, opus, aac, flac, wav.

settings.name: importIntoLibrary
settings.description: When enabled, each generated audio file is imported as a Cove audio item after it is written.

settings.name: skipExisting
settings.description: When enabled, files that already have a matching audio file in the output folder are skipped.
